description_zh: 调用StopDISyncInstance接口，停止实时同步任务
name: StopDISyncInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the synchronization task that you want to stop. Set the value to DI_REALTIME.

DI_REALTIME indicates a real-time synchronization task
parameters.help_zh:
停止数据集成同步任务的任务类型。目前仅支持使用DI_REALTIME类型。

DI_REALTIME代表实时任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: FileId为实时同步任务的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

Data.description_en: The information returned for the synchronization task

Message.description_en:
The reason why the synchronization task fails to be stopped.

If the synchronization task is stopped, the value null is returned
Message.description_zh:
停止数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。

如果停止数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the synchronization task is stopped. Valid values:

success
fail
Status.description_zh:
停止数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示停止数据集成同步任务成功。
fail：表示停止数据集成同步任务失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。 
false：失败
